question: which human dataset is PRIMARY anatomical geometry authority for whole-BNST?

julich_v31_whole_bst.note: current in-repo representation of the primary anatomical family

brandstetter_2026.family: Brandstetter et al. 2026 (Imaging Neuroscience) cytoarchitectonic BST
brandstetter_2026.note: reference-definitional source for canonical cyto subdivision concept; NOT repo-available; NOT assumed equivalent to the stored v3.1 whole map

theiss_blackford_2017.modality: human in-vivo MRI (manual delineation, ~10 healthy subjects)
theiss_blackford_2017.laterality: bilateral single map (world-X split would be a DERIVATION)
theiss_blackford_2017.note: independent MRI-scale clinical corroboration; NOT the primary geometry

sibbach_2024.note: subdivision evidence only; not a whole-BNST authority

equivalence_caveat: the stored Julich-Brain v3.1 whole-BST map (dataset DOI 10.25493/KNSN-XB4) and the Brandstetter 2026 BSTC/D/M/P set (DOI 10.1162/IMAG.a.1260) are BOTH in the Julich cytoarchitectonic BST family, but their exact relationship is NOT assumed from the label; provenance DOIs differ and the 2026 subdivision set is not acquired.
